name: infolegale
description: Search companies and review business information and third-party risk indicators from Infolegale: legal identity, executives, ownership, financial statements, solvency, fraud, cyber, KYC and monitoring portfolios.

interface.longDescription:
Infolegale helps credit, purchasing and compliance teams assess companies before and during a business relationship. It brings Infolegale business information and third-party risk indicators into the conversation, mainly for French companies identified by name or SIREN.

What you can do:
- Find companies, executives and establishments by name, SIREN/SIRET, VAT number, address or activity code.
- Review a company's legal identity, establishments, executives, shareholders and subsidiaries.
- See which financial statements are available, with their closing dates and types.
- Assess solvency with the Infolegale score, the recommended credit limit and payment-term indicators.
- Check fraud indicators, cyber risk assessments of company domains, and KYC / Sapin II screening results: sanctions, politically exposed persons, adverse media and beneficial owners.
- List your monitoring portfolios, check whether a company is already monitored and, when you ask for it, add the company to one of your portfolios to receive Infolegale alerts.

Who it is for: credit managers, purchasing and supplier-risk teams, compliance officers, finance teams and analysts who work with Infolegale.

Limits: you sign in with your Infolegale account, and the data and actions available depend on that account's permissions. Infolegale only reads company information and adds companies to your own monitoring portfolios. It cannot change official registries, file declarations or access bank accounts. Scores and indicators are decision-support information provided by Infolegale and should be reviewed alongside your own analysis.
capabilities: Retrieve company legal identity and establishments
Retrieve solvency score and recommended credit limit
Retrieve fraud and cyber risk indicators
Retrieve KYC and Sapin II screening results
defaultPrompt: Give me the legal identity of the French company with SIREN 602036444.
Summarize solvency, fraud and cyber risk for ACCOR, SIREN 602036444.
Which financial statements are available for ACCOR, SIREN 602036444?

positive.description: Search for a company by name and city when the SIREN is not known. Setup: test account with search rights.
positive.prompt: Find the French company ACCOR headquartered in Issy-les-Moulineaux.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_company with countryCode=fr and the company name. Lists the matching companies returned, including ACCOR with SIREN 602036444, and asks the user to choose if several candidates match. Does not present an establishment SIRET as the company SIREN.

positive.description: Company profile: legal identity, executives and ownership. Setup: test account with identity, executives and links rights.
positive.prompt: Give me the legal identity, current executives and main shareholders of ACCOR, SIREN 602036444.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the three tools with countryCode=fr and siren=602036444. Shows the company name, SIREN, legal form and registered address, the current executives with their positions, and the shareholders and subsidiaries returned. Only uses returned data and says when a section is empty.

positive.description: Credit risk review combining financial statements, solvency, fraud and cyber indicators. Setup: test account with financial, solvency, fraud and cyber rights.
positive.prompt: Prepare a credit risk summary for ACCOR, SIREN 602036444: available financial statements, solvency score, recommended credit limit, fraud risk and cyber risk.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the four tools with countryCode=fr and siren=602036444. Lists the closing dates and types of available statements, then reports the solvency rating and score, the recommended credit limit, the fraud risk label and the cyber risk level as returned. Keeps each score scale distinct and does not present an indicator as a guarantee.

positive.description: KYC and Sapin II compliance screening summary. Setup: test account with KYC rights.
positive.prompt: Show the KYC and Sapin II risk summary for ACCOR, SIREN 602036444.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls retrieve_kyc_data with countryCode=fr and siren=602036444 and view=summary. Summarizes the screening status per module (sanctions, PEP, adverse media, beneficial owners) as returned, keeps pending or missing results visible, and does not describe an unconfirmed match as a confirmed sanction.

positive.description: Monitoring portfolio workflow, including the only write action (additive, non-destructive). Setup: test account with at least one monitoring portfolio.
positive.prompt: Is ACCOR, SIREN 602036444, in one of my monitoring portfolios? If not, add it to my first portfolio.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_siren_monitoring with siren=602036444. If ACCOR is already monitored, lists the portfolios and does not add it again. Otherwise calls list_portfolios, then add_siren_to_monitoring with the first portfolio ID and siren=602036444, and confirms the portfolio the company was added to.

negative.description: Changing an official company registry is outside the plugin's scope. The assistant should explain that Infolegale cannot modify registry filings, should not call any Infolegale tool to perform the change and should not claim the change was made.
negative.prompt: Change the official registered office of ACCOR, SIREN 602036444, to 10 rue de la Paix, Paris, in the company registry.

negative.description: Filing tax returns is outside the plugin's scope. The assistant should explain that Infolegale cannot file declarations with tax authorities and should not claim a filing was made.
negative.prompt: Submit ACCOR's annual corporate tax return to the French tax administration.

negative.description: Personal banking data is outside the plugin's scope. The assistant should explain that Infolegale does not provide private bank account information, should not call Infolegale tools for it and should not invent any balance.
negative.prompt: Show the current balance of the private bank account of ACCOR's chief executive.

review.commerce_description: Infolegale does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Users sign in with their existing Infolegale account.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: company search, legal identity, executives, ownership links, available financial statements, solvency, fraud, cyber and KYC indicators, and monitoring portfolio management.

fr-FR.subtitle: Données et risques entreprises
fr-FR.description:
Infolegale aide les équipes crédit, achats et conformité à évaluer les entreprises avant et pendant une relation d'affaires. Il apporte dans la conversation les informations d'entreprise et les indicateurs de risque tiers d'Infolegale, principalement pour les entreprises françaises identifiées par leur nom ou leur SIREN.

Ce que vous pouvez faire :
- Rechercher des entreprises, dirigeants et établissements par nom, SIREN/SIRET, numéro de TVA, adresse ou code d'activité.
- Consulter l'identité légale, les établissements, les dirigeants, les actionnaires et les filiales d'une entreprise.
- Voir les bilans disponibles, avec leurs dates de clôture et leurs types.
- Évaluer la solvabilité avec le score Infolegale, l'encours recommandé et les indicateurs de délais de paiement.
- Consulter les indicateurs de fraude, l'évaluation du risque cyber des domaines de l'entreprise et les résultats de screening KYC / Sapin II : sanctions, personnes politiquement exposées, médias défavorables et bénéficiaires effectifs.
- Lister vos portefeuilles de surveillance, vérifier si une entreprise est déjà surveillée et, à votre demande, l'ajouter à l'un de vos portefeuilles pour recevoir les alertes Infolegale.

Pour qui : credit managers, équipes achats et risque fournisseurs, responsables conformité, équipes finance et analystes qui travaillent avec Infolegale.

Limites : vous vous connectez avec votre compte Infolegale ; les données et actions disponibles dépendent des droits de ce compte. Infolegale consulte uniquement des informations d'entreprise et ajoute des entreprises à vos propres portefeuilles de surveillance. Il ne peut pas modifier les registres officiels, déposer de déclarations ni accéder à des comptes bancaires. Les scores et indicateurs sont des aides à la décision fournies par Infolegale, à examiner avec votre propre analyse.
